parameters.jsCode: const body=$json.body??$json;const id=String(body.onboarding_id??'');if(!/^[0-9a-f-]{36}$/i.test(id))throw new Error('Valid onboarding_id is required');return[{json:{onboarding_id:id}}];

parameters.query: SELECT o.id AS onboarding_id,c.display_name AS client_name,c.primary_contact_name,c.primary_contact_email,d.name AS engagement,ic.configuration->>'scheduling_url' AS scheduling_url,ic.configuration->>'event_type_name' AS event_type_name FROM app.onboardings o JOIN app.clients c ON c.id=o.client_id JOIN app.deals d ON d.id=o.deal_id JOIN app.integration_connections ic ON ic.provider='calendly' AND ic.health='healthy' WHERE o.id=$1::uuid AND o.status='READY_FOR_KICKOFF';

if(!$json.onboarding_id)throw new Error('Onboarding is not ready for kickoff or Calendly is unavailable');const qs=`name=${encodeURIComponent($json.primary_contact_name)}&email=${encodeURIComponent($json.primary_contact_email)}&utm_content=${encodeURIComponent(String($json.onboarding_id))}`;const link=`${$json.scheduling_url}?${qs}`;const subject=`Schedule your kickoff — ${$json.client_name}`;const html=`

KICKOFF READY

Your onboarding inputs are complete.

Hello ${$json.primary_contact_name},

Your delivery workspace is ready. Choose a convenient time for the ${$json.event_type_name} kickoff meeting.

Schedule kickoff

Engagement: ${$json.engagement}

`;const mime=[`To: ${$json.primary_contact_email}`,`Subject: ${subject}`,'MIME-Version: 1.0','Content-Type: text/html; charset=UTF-8','',html].join('\r\n');const raw=Buffer.from(mime).toString('base64').replace(/\+/g,'-').replace(/\//g,'_').replace(/=+$/,'');return[{json:{...$json,link,raw}}];

parameters.query: WITH delivery AS (INSERT INTO app.email_deliveries(onboarding_id,purpose,recipient,provider_message_id,status,sent_at) VALUES($1::uuid,'kickoff_invitation',$2,$3,'sent',now()) RETURNING provider_message_id,sent_at),audit AS (INSERT INTO app.audit_events(onboarding_id,event_type,title,detail,actor_type,actor_name,metadata) VALUES($1::uuid,'kickoff.invitation_sent','Kickoff scheduling invitation sent','A tracked Calendly scheduling link was sent through Gmail.','integration','Gmail',jsonb_build_object('provider_message_id',$3,'recipient',$2,'scheduling_url',$4)) RETURNING 1) SELECT provider_message_id,sent_at FROM delivery;
